The greedy sequential substitution spends one shirt needed later and reports 14 instead of the achievable minimum 13.

semanticReview.faultyLogic: The substitution branches at lines 14–35 spend a remaining shirt without reserving it for a later exact request; a branch can even decrement a size with zero stock. Exact multiset intersection must be maximized globally, independently of input order.
semanticReview.implementedAlgorithm: Counts exact previous-year sizes, consumes them as requests arrive, and greedily substitutes nearby sizes in the current-size branch. It returns how many requests could not be exact matches.
